title.en: Parents whose children all go to school

say.zh: x 有孩子，而且 x 的孩子都在上学。
say.en: x has children, and all of x’s children go to school.

brief.zh: 拼一句带着 x 的话，在每一家里，让它正好选中「有孩子、孩子又都在上学」的人。
brief.en: Build a sentence with x in it that picks out exactly those who have children, all of whom go to school.

hint.zh: 两件事用 ∧ 连起来：「有孩子」用 ∃，「孩子都在上学」用 ∀。
hint.en: Join two things with ∧: “has children” with ∃, “all children at school” with ∀.

hint.zh: 只写「孩子都在上学」，没有孩子的人也会被选中：对他们，这句话什么都不用查就成立，叫<wiki-ref to="vacuous"></wiki-ref>。
hint.en: With only “all children at school”, those with no children are picked too: for them it holds with nothing to check, a <wiki-ref to="vacuous"></wiki-ref>.
